title: BcPageUpdateInput
description: Update a dashboard page by `page_id`. `row` carries `page_id` (the key, required) plus any columns to change — `name` to rename, or `site_id`/`location_id` to re-pin it under a different site/location. `tenant_id` is bound by the host and cannot be supplied.

row.description: Page row — must include `page_id`; other keys (`name`, `site_id`, `location_id`) are the fields to update.
